# Expo App Skills
Canonical source: `expo/skills` → `plugins/expo/skills` on `main`.

This is a skill pack. Prefer synchronized `upstream/`. For Expo/EAS work, load `expo-overview` first, then only the specific `expo-*` or `eas-*` skill it routes to. If local payload is absent, inspect the canonical upstream directory via authorized GitHub/network access. Do not claim device/build/store results unless actually executed.

State while `upstream/` is absent: `REMOTE_CANONICAL`.
